# hpe_morpheus_security_groups (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of Morpheus security groups, optionally filtered by name, phrase, cloud, visibility, or active state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_security_groups" "example" {
  phrase = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Filter by active state.
- `cloud_id` (Number) Filter to security groups belonging to this cloud (zone) ID.
- `name` (String) Filter by exact security group name (server-side).
- `phrase` (String) Filter by a search phrase matched against name or description (server-side, partial match).
- `visibility` (String) Filter by visibility (e.g. public or private).

### Read-Only

- `security_groups` (Attributes List) The list of security groups matching the supplied filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--security_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_groups`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (Number) The tenant (account) ID that owns the security group.
- `active` (Boolean) Whether the security group is active.
- `cloud_id` (Number) The cloud (zone) ID for the security group.
- `description` (String) The description of the security group.
- `enabled` (String) Whether the security group is enabled (on/off).
- `external_id` (String) The external ID of the security group.
- `group_source` (String) The source of the security group.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the security group.
- `name` (String) The name of the security group.
- `resource_permission_group_ids` (Set of Number) Set of group IDs that have access to the security group.
- `resource_permission_groups_all` (Boolean) Whether all groups have access to the security group.
- `sync_source` (String) The sync source of the security group.
- `tenant_ids` (Set of Number) Set of tenant IDs that are allowed access to the security group.
- `visibility` (String) The visibility of the security group.
